_comment: PADIS 규칙 초안 v1. build_padis_kg_from_approved.py 가 읽는 스키마(rule_id/subject/relation/object)를 그대로 따르되, 파일명은 draft 로 둔다 — padis_rules_approved.json 은 사람이 approve_rules.py 로 승인한 결과여야 하므로 건드리지 않았다. 승인 후 이 배열을 그쪽으로 옮긴다.
source_guideline: PADIS 2018 (Devlin et al., Crit Care Med)
schema_note: grade / source / mimic_ready / needs_new_relation 은 확장 필드다. KG 빌더는 무시하고, 공리 가중치(GRADE)와 매핑 점검에 쓴다.

approved_rules.subject: Benzodiazepine
approved_rules.source_text: Benzodiazepine use and blood transfusion administration are the only two modifiable factors with strong evidence for an association with delirium detected by screening tools.

approved_rules.subject: BloodTransfusion
approved_rules.source_text: Benzodiazepine use and blood transfusion administration are the only two modifiable factors with strong evidence for an association with delirium.
approved_rules.note: inputevents 에서 수혈을 별도 추출해야 한다. 현재 00_extract.py 대상 밖.

approved_rules.subject: SedationIntensity
approved_rules.grade: cohort evidence, not in guideline grading
approved_rules.source_text: Sedation intensity (sum of negative RASS measurements by number of assessments) independently, in an escalating dose-dependent relationship, predicts increased risk of death, delirium, and delayed time to extubation.

approved_rules.subject: SedationIntensity
approved_rules.grade: cohort evidence, not in guideline grading
approved_rules.source_text: ... predicts increased risk of death, delirium, and delayed time to extubation.

approved_rules.subject: DeepSedation
approved_rules.source_text: escalating dose-dependent relationship between sedation intensity and delirium

approved_rules.subject: DeepSedation
approved_rules.source_text: 가이드라인 문장이 아니라 우리 데이터에서 온 관측. 관측가능성 술어를 논리층에 넣기 위한 다리.
approved_rules.note: 이 규칙만 출처가 PADIS 가 아니다. 논문에서는 별도 표기 필요.

approved_rules.subject: PhysicalRestraint
approved_rules.source_text: These events include more unplanned extubations ... and increased risk for delirium or disorientation.
approved_rules.note: restraint itemid 값 미추출 · stay 보유율 50.1% 로 결측이 크다.

approved_rules.subject: Age
approved_rules.source_text: For the following risk factors, strong evidence indicates that these are associated with delirium in critically ill adults: 'modifiable' ... and 'nonmodifiable' - greater age.

approved_rules.subject: Delirium
approved_rules.source_text: Delirium in critically ill adults is associated with increased mortality and prolonged ICU stay.

approved_rules.subject: Delirium
approved_rules.source_text: 섬망 환자는 조기 거동 달성이 낮다.

approved_rules.subject: Dexmedetomidine
approved_rules.source_text: SEDCOM had the greatest benefit for ... delirium (RR, 0.71; 95% CI, 0.61-0.83) with dexmedetomidine compared with a benzodiazepine infusion.

approved_rules.subject: Propofol
approved_rules.source_text: nonbenzodiazepine sedatives (either propofol or dexmedetomidine) are preferable to benzodiazepine sedatives ... because of improved short-term outcomes such as ICU LOS, duration of mechanical ventilation, and delirium.
approved_rules.note: 엄밀히는 benzo 대비 상대적 우위다. 절대적 보호 효과로 읽으면 과장이다.

approved_rules.subject: EarlyMobility
approved_rules.source_text: improvements in bundle compliance were significantly associated with reduced mortality and more ICU days without coma or delirium.
approved_rules.note: mobility 값 미추출. 번들 전체의 효과라 조기거동 단독 효과로 귀속하는 것은 약하다.

approved_rules.subject: SeverePain
approved_rules.source_text: The outcomes associated with opioid safety concerns such as ... delirium ... must be evaluated carefully.
approved_rules.note: pain NRS 값 미추출 · stay 보유율 96.2% 로 추출만 하면 된다. 통증-섬망 방향성은 PADIS 에서 약하게 진술된다.

_summary.blocker: decreasesRiskOf 가 configs/relation_vocab.json 에 없다. 예방 권고 3건이 현재 vocabulary 로 표현 불가.
